theorems.name: Workhouse.PlateauObstruction.stationary_global_minimum

theorems.name: Workhouse.PlateauObstruction.logarithmic_time_is_stationary
theorems.scope: For A, plateau, a, b positive, t0=log(A*a/(plateau*b))/(a+b) satisfies the exact stationary balance.

theorems.name: Workhouse.PlateauObstruction.admissible_logarithmic_minimum
theorems.scope: Under plateau*b <= A*a and positivity, the logarithmic optimum is nonnegative and minimizes the objective over nonnegative physical times.

theorems.name: Workhouse.PlateauObstruction.endpoint_minimum
theorems.scope: If A*a <= plateau*b, the constrained objective is bounded below by its attained time-zero value A+plateau.

theorems.name: Workhouse.PlateauObstruction.interior_minimum_value
theorems.scope: The exact attained logarithmic minimum equals ((a+b)/a)*plateau*(A*a/(plateau*b))^(b/(a+b)), with every positive-factor condition explicit.
